title: Smoked Sausage and Red Beans
description: Good ole red beans and sausage with rice. I put lots of garlic in it, which makes it tasty. I take it to my bingo crowd, and they love it! I usually don't measure, so I decided to write it down while I was making it. This is medium on the heat but make it as hot as you like!
ingredients: 3 pounds smoked sausage, cut into bite-sized pieces
8 (15 ounce) cans dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
4 dashes hot pepper sauce, or to taste

steps.text: In a 6-quart or larger slow cooker, combine smoked sausage, kidney beans, water, rice, onion, and garlic. Season with Cajun seasoning, hot pepper sauce, salt, and bay leaf. Cover and set on High. Once mixture is heated through, stir until well combined.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours or High for 4 hours.
